result.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.ts the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)` and then persists `data: { key }`. Per parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, the return value is the Zod safeParse result (SafeParseReturnType with `success`/`data` fields), not the parsed data, so the whole wrapper object is stored as the credential key, corrupting it on every refresh.

judged_text: packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:97-101 — `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema); await prisma.credential.update({..., data: { key } })` stores the entire Zod `SafeParseReturnType` wrapper object (`{ success, data }`) as the credential's `key` instead of the parsed token fields (`key.data`), corrupting the stored google credential on every token refresh
